title: Untitled (Targets and Planes)
description: Framed mixed-media collage densely layered with top-down warplane silhouettes, concentric target rings, and grid elements across a fragmented white, red, and ochre ground. Vertical ribbon stripes and polka-dot passages punctuate the composition alongside black square motifs and scattered perforated-dot details.
composition: dense layered fragments across horizontal plane
